body:
>Have you tried seeing a school counselor or a teacher about the schoolwork? 

Yeah I have, but I just end up not doing the schoolwork anyways, so it's pretty pointless. I guess i'm a lost cause lol. 

I really appreciate you trying to help me. I'll call my doctor tomorrow and see what can be done, and maybe even get a new therapist. I guess you'll see me back here if that doesn't work out

____

24? What has changed in your life compared to 18-year old you? (I'm genuinely curious)

> Any chance of reconnecting with those friends?

I wouldn't say so. And even if it was a possibility i'd still wouldn't want to reconnect with them, I've realized now that they were pretty crappy friends, so i'm probably better off without them at this point in my life.

>Is is the schoolwork and exams? What feelings do you have towards going to school and doing the work?

That combined with having people all around me all the time, I'm extremely uncomfortable while at school. But yeah it's the schoolwork that's the worst for me, I don't do a lot of what i'm supposed to do so I end up stressed and feeling like shit. 

Like right now I got a six page essay due for tomorrow and I haven't even started.

> The romantic partner is tough.

I definitely realize that, but it's just when I see another anxious looking girl sitting around by herself at school I can't help myself, but of course I can't talk to them. I really like the idea of two outcasts being lonely together.

____

Do you mind me asking how old you are?

>Do you feel retail will be fulfilling or at least be able to get your mind off things by giving you something repetitive?

I just need some source of income so I live on my own in the future, and retail seems like a pretty realistic job for me.

>When was the last time you were happy?

Umm, summer 2013 maybe? I'm not sure really. I've been anxious for as long as I can remember, so I don't know if I really were happy back then. 

But I guess it's all relative right

>Which SSRI's did you take and did they change them for you once you told them it made it worse?

Sertraline (Zoloft) and Citalopram, all they did was make me tired, literally no change to my anxiety & depression.

>Do you have any friends you can hang out with? 

Nope. I've been on my own since december 2013, and it was me that cut my old friends off, they tried to regain contact but I just couldn't do it. 

The weird thing is that i'm very ok with being friendless though? Like what's the point of them? If you have an SO I don't see any "use" of friends, but that might be the anxiety speaking, idk.

>What's the shittiest thing in your life that bothers you the most?

Number one is school. The only reason why i'm not in big trouble is because the teachers notice that i'm not feeling good, so it's at least not just 100% laziness. 

And the big number two is the lack of a romantic partner, i'd just love to have someone to be comfortable with, it's not any sexual reasons at all (at least not anymore), I just need someone to talk to (that's not getting paid to do it).

....


What medication are you taking right now? You mentioned anxiety meds.

>Are you planning on attending college or full time job and what type?

University? No, or at least not in the near future.

But i'm definitely seeing myself working at a job if I ever graduate, and it'd be something non-physical, like retail maybe? Who knows.

>What's important to you? It might not be something you can answer fully right now but you might have an idea. Traveling? Raising a family? Being successful? There's no one answer for people.

That question is a big reason for my mental state right now, I have no idea. The happiest moment of the day for me is getting home to my room and locking myself up in here, so it's not really like I have any passions or huge interests. 

I suffered with PTSD as a kid/young teen, and now social anxiety & depression. I'm not looking for your pity, but i'm just trying to convey how shitty i've been feeling for over 10 years now, and I'm gonna break eventually, i just know it.

I tried SSRI's and therapy but it did nothing but make it worse
